user.title: Configure room heating
user.description: Creates read-only energy estimates. It never controls thermostats and does not modify Better Thermostat. Rooms are added one at a time on the next screen.

data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: Enables the weather-normalised heat demand status per room.

data.name: Room name
data.external_heat_entities: Heat pumps or external-heat binary sensors

data_description.initial_valve_hours: Leave at 0 unless migrating mid-month from an older setup.
data_description.better_thermostat_extension_enabled: Adds external-heat guards and opening-contact data. When disabled, the integration does not affect Better Thermostat learning.
data_description.external_heat_entities: Climate entities count only while hvac_action is heating. Binary sensors count while on.
data_description.stove_temperature_entity: Uses hysteresis so normal sensor noise does not repeatedly pause and resume learning.

error.invalid_room: Enter a unique room name, a climate entity, and positive numbers for power, area and radiator count.
error.invalid_sensor: The optional sensor entity must start with sensor.

abort.already_configured: Room Energy Optimizer is already configured.
